violated_contract: A future derived from another future solely for bookkeeping must not re-emit the original failure as an unhandled asynchronous error after an awaiting caller observes it. Dropping an error-propagating whenComplete or then branch can otherwise report a caller-handled failure a second time through the app's fatal top-level handler.
canonical_prevention: Keep returning or awaiting the original operation future so its value and error remain caller-visible. Explicitly consume errors on detached bookkeeping futures, including failures from cleanup callbacks, rather than dropping an error-propagating derived future. Guard the behavior with zone-aware tests that observe caller failures, reject duplicate unhandled errors, and verify cleanup on success and failure.
